# The format characters a device name may not carry: bidirectional controls and overrides,
# zero-width and joiner characters, the byte-order mark, the soft hyphen. One hex code point or
# an inclusive range (XXXX-YYYY) per line; '#' starts a comment.
#
# Two lists strip them and must agree: `pairing::is_format_char` (Rust, services/ruya-devices) and
# `DeviceIcons.plain` (QML, shell/qml/DeviceIcons.qml). A Rust test (pairing.rs) and
# tst_bluetooth.qml read this file and compare every code point of the Basic Multilingual Plane
# against it, so a character added to only one side fails. Control characters (C0, DEL, C1) are
# handled separately on both sides and are not listed.
00AD
061C
180E
200B-200F
202A-202E
2060-206F
FEFF
